dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Moderate concave curvature visible along the posterior margin from the basal ridge to the apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded apex with a smooth curvature transition.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Acute angular steepness approximately 55 degrees relative to the longitudinal dorsal ridge.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Approximately 1.1:1 ratio of base width to vertical height.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Pronounced convex arc with a smooth, semi-circular radius.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short and robust beak with a low length-to-thickness ratio protruding from the cranial base.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Distinct obtuse angle at the transition point between the melon's descent and the rostrum's emergence.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Small V-shaped notch located on the lower third of the dorsal fin's trailing edge.
other_distinctive_markers: High-contrast light caustic patterns visible across the dorsal and lateral surfaces due to water surface refraction.
